Yes — this is exactly what I meant by having my collection safely back in my own hands. I hit "Download full backup" and it produced a single restorable file that listed everything it holds: all my bookmarks with their titles and descriptions, my labels, the dates, my reading and put-away states, and — importantly — the saved page copies and the original PDFs too. That's the reassurance I was after: if anything ever happened, I could get my whole library back, not just a bare list of links.

And I like that there's a second, plainer file just of names and addresses (with my labels as folders) for moving into a browser or another tool — with it being honest that the richer saved copies don't travel in that lighter one. That distinction makes sense to me and doesn't overpromise.

So import and export are both settled now, and that was the big pair I really wanted before calling this my complete setup. The two lighter ones are still open whenever you're ready — saving a search I use often so I can pull it back with one click, and a few comfort settings (how many show at once, text size, default order). Could we do those next?
